title: The Silent Vector
shortDescription: Four crew members. Everyone remembers a fifth.
description:
You are the engineer on Asterion, a deep-space research station. A signal has returned from an outer relay, and the crew now remembers a colleague who has no place in the station's physical records.

Restore cooling, compare independent records, and find out why your colleagues remember someone the instruments can't account for. Then decide how to bring the crew home and what to do with the signal.

An original science fiction horror adventure with fourteen rooms, integrated engineering and deduction puzzles, optional progressive hints, and two deliberate endings. No timed deaths. Content includes involuntary memory, bereavement, and psychological distress.
author: Studio Null
